mapper.select:
SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.member_id, CASE WHEN c.status = 'PUBLISHED' THEN c.content END AS content, c.status, c.created_at
FROM comments c
WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.parent_comment_id IS NULL
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.parent_comment_id AS parent_id, COUNT(*) AS reply_count
FROM comments c
WHERE c.parent_comment_id IN
#{parentId}
GROUP BY c.parent_comment_id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.parent_comment_id IS NULL), 0) AS root_row_count, COALESCE(SUM(c.status = 'PUBLISHED'), 0) AS published_count
FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = #{postId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (post_id, member_id, content, status) VALUES (#{postId}, #{memberId}, #{content}, 'PUBLISHED')

INSERT INTO comments (post_id, member_id, parent_comment_id, content, status) SELECT parent.post_id, #{memberId}, parent.id, #{content}, 'PUBLISHED' FROM comments parent WHERE parent.id = #{parentCommentId} AND parent.post_id = #{postId} AND parent.parent_comment_id IS NULL AND parent.status = 'PUBLISHED'
